item.description:
Symphonia 1.0.1 warns you when players may not be able to find it.

  • New warning on the status page. After an install or update, macOS can sometimes block Symphonia's access to your network, even when System Settings shows it as allowed. Your music players then can't find Symphonia, though the status page still opens. If Symphonia hears nothing from any other device on your network for 10 minutes, the status page now says so and explains how to fix it.
  • The fix, if you see it: on the Mac running Symphonia, open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network, turn Symphonia off and on again, then quit and reopen Symphonia.
